text:
marta: heads up — canary for aurora-liteq (v0.9-q) shows a spike in funcall parse failures vs raven-v2 baseline. throwing ~2.8% parse rejects on the acceptance suite, mostly trailing commas / partial arrays / null-in-fields.
kevin: can you paste an example output?
marta: sure — here's one from the canary run (raw model output, unmodified):
```\n{\n  \"action\": \"update_ticket\",\n  \"params\": [{\"ticket_id\": 12345, \"fields\": [\"status\", \"priority\",],}, null]\n}\n```\nmarta: parser immediately fails and triggers a retry path. we've been seeing a lot of these when quantized to int8 with the new kernel pack.
samir: is this concentrated on streaming responses or non-streaming?
marta: both, but streaming has the worst fragmentation — suffix gets cut off mid-array then sentinel isn't present. non-streaming sometimes has trailing comma or unexpected nulls.
olivia: that matches the kvcache warmstart hypothesis — small batches + prefix caching could be truncating buffers. can you share canary config?
marta: running with: `--canary-config=aurora-liteq:1% traffic, batch=8, max-toks=512, kv-warmup=0.1s`
kevin: two quick probes: 1) run a non-quantized aurora baseline with same canary config; 2) increase kv-warmup to 0.5s and re-run. see if fragmentation drops.
canary-bot: deploy triggered: canary 1785312468 -> run-id 20260321-aurora-liteq-replay-1
marta: replaying now with unquantized aurora. patching canary settings to kv-warmup=0.5s.
samir: also add a soft-json-coerce postprocess that strips trailing commas and collapses lone nulls in arrays for the canary mirror only — don't roll to prod until we see perf impact.
kevin: agree. add a telemetry tag so we can separate coerced vs strict-parsed. please log which heuristic ran.
olivia: can we get a microbenchmark that isolates tokenizer/decoder differences for int8 kernel? if quantization increases token-level control-chars frequency that could explain extra commas.
marta: launching a microbench: `./bench/invoke_compare --models aurora:fp16,aurora-liteq:int8 --prompts small-json-suite.json --n=5k`
marta: initial numbers — raven-v2 baseline parse-fail: 0.3%, aurora fp16: 0.4%, aurora-liteq:int8: 2.9% (same suite).
samir: that's a big gap. please attach example tokens around the suffix boundary (token hex or detokenized).
marta: attaching small snippet (detokenized with markers):
```\n... \u2581\u2581params\u2581:\u2581[\"status\",\"priority\",],\n\u2581}\n```\nmarta: looks like decoder inserts an extra comma token sequence in some post-quant states.
kevin: action items: 1) infra: run kv-warmup ramp and replay (kevin) 2) ml: run token-level detokenization diffs + kernel sanity (marta + samir) 3) eng: implement canary-only soft-json-coerce + telemetry (olivia) 4) product: hold rollout until <1% parse-fail (marta).
olivia: I'm adding the soft-coerce PR to the canary mirror branch now. will tag telemetry as `parse_coerce=v1`.
kevin: replay with kv-warmup=0.5s in progress -> will report delta in 30m.
canary-bot: replay completed: run-id 20260321-aurora-liteq-replay-1 -> parse-fail delta: -0.6% (from 2.9% to 2.3%)
marta: partial improvement but not enough. coerce PR landed to mirror branch.
samir: once coerce is on, run canary mirror and compute false-positive rate where coercion changes semantics. need precision metric: how often coercion changes an intent field (e.g., removes a real null).
olivia: will add a safety net: only coerce trailing commas and stray commas inside arrays; do not remove explicit `null` unless it's duplicated.
marta: running mirror now. will post numbers.
canary-bot: mirror run complete -> parse-fail: 0.8% ; coercion-applied: 1.9% of responses; semantics-changed: 0.04%
marta: nice drop to 0.8% parse-fail. semantics-changed is low but we still need to audit the 0.04% cases.
kevin: for the audit, sample 200 of the changed responses and check intent parity. prioritize customer-facing routes.
samir: also let's add a regression test to the onboarding harness: if quantized model increases parse-fail by >0.5% absolute vs fp16 for the same config, fail onboarding.
olivia: onboarding harness PR: added threshold check + slack alert to eng-ml channel.
marta: summary for the ticket: quantized kernel likely increases tokenized comma noise causing structured-output parse failures; mitigations: kv-warmup tuning, canary-only soft-coerce, stricter onboarding regression gates. next steps: audit semantics sample (kevin), kernel dive (samir), decide long-term fix (model retrain/decoder tweak) (marta).
kevin: thanks — ping me when sample is ready. :thumbsup:
marta: will do. closing this thread once audit done.
